summary: Global Ship Lease, Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC attaching a notice, proxy statement, and proxy card for its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders to be held on June 17, 2026. The meeting will cover routine proposals: electing three Term III Directors, ratifying the appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers S.A. as independent auditor, and approving the Company's Second Amended and Restated Articles of Incorporation. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other corporate action is indicated. This is a routine annual meeting notification without any forced management changes or extraordinary items.
